question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Valiance
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Gallantry'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Valiance"** refers to the quality of showing courage or determination.(वीरता)
 
• The word that means the same as** "Valiance"** is: '**Gallantry'.**
 
• **"Gallantry"** means courageous behavior, especially in battle.(शौर्य)

Therefore, the **correct answer **is:** 'Gallantry'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dastardliness: **This refers to despicable cowardice.(कायरता)
 
• **Cravenness: **This word also refers to extreme cowardice.(भीरुता)
 
• **Patience: **This refers to the capacity to accept or tolerate delay, trouble, or suffering without getting angry or upset.(धैर्य)
